title: Bounded Foundation workspace delta capture
description: Objective: derive the four M1 Foundation capture inputs from a trusted clean prelaunch workspace and real postlaunch bytes, instead of caller-shaped result facts. MEASURED at HEAD f81ab75: buildResultManifest is a sealer, not a scanner; it accepts authoredPaths/resultTreeEntries and its contract explicitly defers broader candidate sealing. A postlaunch dirty observation cannot itself bless authored bytes. Deliverable: a public @moe/runner Foundation capture scanner that first proves an assigned worktree's actual bounded tree exactly equals its sealed input under the trusted clean prelaunch ScopeObservation, then re-observes/scans after launch, derives unchanged INHERITED entries, new/changed AUTHORED entries, and deleted authored paths, fixes declaredArtifactRefs to the closed M1 value [], and delegates final validation/sealing to buildResultManifest using the PRELAUNCH observation. The result remains an advisory Foundation attempt core, not an accepted candidate or integration result. NOT in scope: resolving host refs, creating/removing worktrees, daemon persistence, artifact declaration, authored Git commit, verification/review/acceptance, or provider launch. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/workspace/foundation-workspace-capture-contract.ts/.js, foundation-workspace-capture-node.ts/.js, foundation-workspace-capture-node.test.ts, packages/runner/src/index.ts, packages/runner/src/index-surface.test.ts. Consumer: the prepare-before-launch lifecycle task created by this split; record its exact id before completion. Verification command: `pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck; $a=$LASTEXITCODE; pnpm --filter @moe/runner test; $b=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "RUNNER_TC=$a RUNNER_TEST=$b"; if ($a -ne 0 -or $b -ne 0) { exit 1 }`, with nonzero printed counts.
definitionOfDone: The public input contract accepts only an exact assigned real root, sealed WorkspaceInputManifest, authoritative declared paths, trusted clean prelaunch ScopeObservation, Git/path observer ports, bounded scanner limits, and daemon observation metadata; it contains no authoredPaths, resultTreeEntries, artifact refs, result bytes, or request/launch template.

Prelaunch capture enumerates every declared subtree without following symlinks/junctions, brackets containment/stat/read checks, bounds entry count and aggregate bytes, and proves the scanned regular-file path/digest/length set exactly equals the sealed input manifest; extra, missing, changed, escaped, unreadable, unsupported, or TOCTOU-swapped bytes refuse rather than shrink.

Postlaunch capture re-observes the same root/base, reconciles global Git changed paths against authoritative scopes, refuses any out-of-scope change as OUT_OF_SCOPE_HOST_EFFECT_UNKNOWN at RUNNER_WORKSPACE_CAPTURE, and refuses staged/unmerged/ignored/contradictory states with the exact runner code/layer that decided them.

The derived output maps unchanged input bytes to INHERITED, new or changed regular files to AUTHORED, and deleted input paths to authoredPaths without a result entry; every list is complete, canonical, sorted, deeply frozen, and passed to production buildResultManifest with the clean PRELAUNCH observation and declaredArtifactRefs exactly [].

Focused pure and real-temp-Git tests include accepted modify/create/delete controls, hostile path/symlink/junction/overflow/TOCTOU arms, out-of-scope change and caller-smuggling sweeps with asserted nonzero counts, and exact code plus layer; mutations skipping digest comparison or containment redden named production-surface tests.

The exact production consumer task id is recorded, the @moe/runner surface ratchet and plain-Node bridge loads pass, runner typecheck/test exit 0 with nonzero counts, and every production source targets <=250 lines and stays below 400.
taskRails: This scanner derives advisory Foundation result facts only; it must not claim final candidate acceptance, an authored commit, verification, integration, or review authority.
Use the trusted clean prelaunch ScopeObservation for buildResultManifest; a postlaunch DIRTY/STAGED/UNTRACKED observation is evidence to classify/refuse, never authority to bless bytes.
Git changed paths cannot declare their own scope. Any changed path outside the catalog-authorized scope fails closed as OUT_OF_SCOPE_HOST_EFFECT_UNKNOWN.
Do not accept caller-authored paths, tree entries, artifact refs, or bytes, and do not duplicate buildResultManifest's canonical sealing rules.

BRACKET (new code, as the plan said it must be): readBracketed in foundation-workspace-capture-node.ts chains five links — lstat names the object and its dev:ino identity; openRead takes a handle; fstat on THAT HANDLE must equal the lstat identity; realpath containment is resolved and tied back by lstat(resolved).identity === handle identity; a final fstat must still match the bytes just read. Enumeration is lstat/dirent-kind only, never follows a link.

TOCTOU ARM IS NOT SELF-SATISFYING: the swap rewrites the file with the SAME bytes. A path-keyed read would hash identical content and the equality proof would pass; only the identity comparison can see it. Asserts swaps === 1 so the arm proves it actually ran.

BUDGETS: own MAX_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_ENTRIES=100_000 / MAX_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_BYTES=512MiB plus caller-narrowable limits; a caller widening past a ceiling gets INPUT_INVALID. Byte overflow refuses mid-scan and the test asserts no proof field survives.

The observation is now snapshotted CLEAN first, which is also the real lifecycle order, so each arm actually reaches the prover it names.

implementationPlan.description: Postlaunch capture, TDD RED first: re-observe the SAME root and base (observeScope, scope-observation.ts:117), reconcile the git attribution's changedPaths (ScopeGitAttribution: changedPaths/dirtyPaths/stagedPaths/untrackedPaths/unmergedPaths — already the sorted union incl. the contradictory bucket) against the AUTHORITATIVE declared scopes via the existing containment (isContainedBy, workspace-contract.ts:252-254; governingScopeEntry longest-match, workspace-result-rules.ts:36-50): ANY out-of-scope change refuses — an attempt that wrote outside its scopes produced unblessable state, full stop. In-scope: derive unchanged INHERITED entries (same path+digest+length as sealed input), new/changed AUTHORED entries (rescanned with the same bracketed snapshot discipline), and deleted authored paths. Unmerged or contradictory git records refuse (a crash is not a refusal; a contradictory index is neither clean nor authored).

captureFoundationWorkspaceDelta re-observes the SAME root/base through observeScope, then in order: forward an observer refusal under RUNNER_SCOPE_OBSERVATION with the observer's OWN code; root re-check; outOfScopeRejection over gitAttribution.changedPaths vs the authoritative declaration; gitStateRejection; rescan with the same bracket; deriveCapture; seal.

MEASURED CORRECTION to the planned ignored/contradictory checks. The plan had all four index-state checks read changedPaths. Two of them are wrong there:
- IGNORED: createNodeGitObserver runs `status --porcelain=v2 -z --untracked-files=all` WITHOUT --ignored and `ls-files --others --ignored`, so an ignored path is never in changedPaths. changed-INTERSECT-ignored is the empty set on every real host, i.e. dead code. Moved to the DECLARATION: a canonicalEntries entry whose attribution is IGNORED refuses. That IS reachable and the arm proves it with a real .gitignore + a real ignored file.
- UNMERGED/STAGED stay on the PATH buckets, deliberately: buildAttributionIndex folds a declared directory to the strongest class in its subtree (scope-attribution.ts RANK), so one new file (UNTRACKED rank 2) masks a staged sibling (STAGED rank 3) and a staged result would sail through a per-scope read.
- Dropped the planned BASE_MOVED code: observeScope refuses a moved HEAD first with RUNNER_SCOPE_HEAD_MISMATCH, and the arm asserts that forwarding, so a capture-owned code would have been unreachable.

Authorship is decided by BYTES, not by git's opinion: an identical rewrite git calls changed stays INHERITED (own arm).

Accepted controls: modify, create, delete, zero-change, identical-rewrite. Deleted-INHERITED-in-scope becomes an authored path with NO result entry; a deletion outside scope refuses instead — both pinned, the distinction does not collapse.

Refusal arms, each asserting code AND layer: OUT_OF_SCOPE_HOST_EFFECT_UNKNOWN (real out-of-scope write), STAGED_STATE (real git add), IGNORED_STATE (real .gitignore), UNMERGED_STATE and CONTRADICTORY_STATE (real production parsePorcelainV2/observeScope/gitStateRejection driven by an injected GitObserver emitting the exact porcelain v2 bytes git would; real git will not emit an XY of ".." on demand - same rationale scope-git.test.ts records), PROOF_UNSEALED, RUNNER_SCOPE_HEAD_MISMATCH @ RUNNER_SCOPE_OBSERVATION, RUNNER_WORKSPACE_ENTRY_DUPLICATE @ RUNNER_WORKSPACE_MANIFEST (case-only rename, refused only by the sealer).

Caller-smuggling sweep over 5 forbidden keys on BOTH entry points; asserts proved === 5 and captured === 5 (nonzero counts, not just "no crash") and that each smuggled proof digest is byte-identical to the clean control.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW FOUND FOUR REAL DEFECTS, ALL FIXED BEFORE COMMIT:
1. AUTHORITY HOLE. prelaunchProofDigestInput binds inputManifest.sha256 and prelaunchObservation.sha256 - the DIGEST FIELDS, not the bodies. A caller could hand back {...proof, inputManifest: {...m, entries: [forged]}} and the proof seal still recomputed, because the mutated field never enters the digest. captureFoundationWorkspaceDelta now re-verifies BOTH bodies' own seals. Two arms, drill (v).
2. CRASH INSTEAD OF REFUSAL. An absent fs port, a non-record manifest/observation, or a string declaredScopePaths (new Set("work") silently yields four one-character "paths") each produced a TypeError, which carries no reason code. shapeRejection now refuses all of them with INPUT_INVALID; a 6-case sweep asserts refused === 6.
3. UNBOUNDED ALLOCATION. The byte budget was spent AFTER readHandle, so a 5 GiB file exhausted memory to learn it was over budget. Budgeted from the lstat now, before the open; the post-read check stays for a file that grew. The arm asserts reads === 0, not merely that it refused.
4. STACK OVERFLOW. The entry budget counts FILES, so a directory-only chain recursed without spending it. MAX_SCAN_DEPTH=64 with its own DEPTH_LIMIT code; the arm builds a real 70-deep chain.
Also removed a dead catch branch that could never fire (every rule above it returns rather than throws).

ADVERSARIAL SCENARIOS FROM THE PLAN, all covered: deleted-INHERITED-in-scope becomes an authored deletion with no result entry while an out-of-scope deletion refuses (distinction pinned by two arms); a zero-authored-change attempt is ACCEPTED with an empty authored set; the entry budget and the mid-scan aggregate-bytes overflow both refuse with no partial answer; case-colliding paths are refused by the SEALER under its own layer.
